captions.detailed: A professional DSLR camera speedlight flash in matte black. It features a bottom mounting shoe, a tall rectangular body with a rear-facing LCD screen and physical controls, and a swiveling upper flash head supported by side yokes. The flash head rotates horizontally relative to the main body and tilts vertically between the side yokes, while the rear control interface features a rotating selector dial and four separate push buttons.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a professional camera flash. The model should include a mounting foot, a main control body with a rear LCD display and control buttons, and a forward-facing flash head. Ensure the head can swivel horizontally and pitch vertically, and include a rotatable selector dial surrounded by four separate push buttons on the rear interface.
captions.factory: Construct the main body using a Box with filleted vertical edges to form the main housing, adding a thin Box for the mounting foot. Model the LCD screen and bezels using nested, shallow boxes on the rear face. Create the yoke using a U-shaped union of boxes, and the flash head using a chamfered Box representing the light diffuser. Define a revolute joint for the horizontal swivel between the body and yoke, a revolute joint for the vertical pitch of the flash head, a continuous rotation joint for the selector dial, and prismatic joints for each of the four surrounding push buttons.
